summary: Welcome page background image visibility fix verified. All Checkpoint A-D requirements passed: background image is now visible in both light and dark themes on desktop and mobile, footer uses semi-transparent background allowing background treatment to show through, text/cards/nav remain readable.
critical_code_review_comments: Background image fix verified: Desktop parallax background uses opacity 0.2 (light) / 0.34 (dark) - visible but not overwhelming
Desktop overlay uses lighter gradients: light theme ~51-55% alpha, dark theme ~62-74% alpha - allows image to show through
Mobile background overlay uses semi-transparent backgrounds: light ~48% alpha, dark ~67% alpha
Footer now uses semi-transparent background (rgba with ~54% alpha in dark mode) instead of fully opaque - allows background treatment to show through
Text readability maintained: brand name, nav links, and content cards all visible with proper contrast in both themes
FloatingImageShowcase component renders correctly with rotating images and dot indicators
context_for_next_testing_agent: Welcome page background image fix verified. The fix adjusted overlay opacity values in welcome.tsx (lines 1253-1289) and made footer background semi-transparent in Footer.tsx (line 560-561). All V2 light/dark theme compliance requirements met.
